name: yestoall
description: Public skills for the yestoall apps and tools (Nevera and Tipos). One plugin each.

plugins.name: nevera
plugins.description: Turn YouTube cooking videos, Instagram reels and posts, and recipe web pages into a recipe batch with photos that opens in Nevera.

plugins.name: tipos
plugins.description: Change the type of your website or app with Tipos: your AI opens each part of your interface in Tipos with the type it has today, and puts what you tune back in your code.
